name: OCK Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，OCK Group Berhad 推进了 EI Power Berhad 在 ACE Market 的上市，并向股东进行受限发售；同时，公司宣布以库存股形式派发股息。业务板块方面，公告资料未披露各板块的具体扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: In 2026, OCK Group Berhad progressed the listing of EI Power Berhad on the ACE Market and undertook a restricted offering to shareholders; it also announced a dividend-in-specie via treasury shares. At the segment level, the announcements do not disclose specific expansion, reduction, or contract activities.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 推进 EI Power Berhad 上市及向股东进行受限发售，并宣布以库存股派发股息。
segments.note_en: Progressed the listing of EI Power Berhad and a restricted offering to shareholders, and announced a dividend-in-specie via treasury shares.

actions.title: OCK - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布以库存股形式派发股息。
actions.text_en: Announced a dividend-in-specie via treasury shares on the basis of three treasury shares for every one hundred ordinary shares held.

actions.title: OCK - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 就 EI Power Berhad 上市，向 OCK 股东进行 14,000,000 股新普通股的受限发售，占 EIP 扩大后股本的 2.0%。
actions.text_en: In conjunction with the listing of EI Power Berhad, undertook a restricted offering of 14,000,000 new ordinary shares to OCK shareholders, representing 2.0% of EIP's enlarged share capital.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED LISTING OF AND QUOTATION FOR THE ENTIRE ENLARGED ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF EI POWER BERHA
actions.text_en: Issued a circular to shareholders in relation to the proposed listing of and quotation for the entire enlarged issued share capital of EI Power Berhad on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED LISTING OF AND QUOTATION FOR THE ENTIRE ENLARGED ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF EI POWER BERHA
model_changes.text: 涉及向股东进行受限发售。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed the listing of EI Power Berhad on the ACE Market, involving a restricted offering to shareholders.
